dataList.description:
A scarf given by the woman in blue who bears a resemblance to Demian. Carrying it brings the strange sensation of being sheltered from all things.

Whether it is pity for failure or encouragement for the road still ahead, there is a warmth to it like the sea.

The sea is frightening for how little one can know of its depths... and yet it feels as though it might take everything into its embrace.

dataList.description:
Like any other stranger, he entered through 1F, became a customer, and, after a long time, endured enough to rise to Floor Manager. This is an object created by that entity.

He endured the passage of time and the Age until endurance itself became second nature.

dataList.description:
He had a role assigned to him. A job.

The work was standardized, codified into manuals. He would report to Sisyphe Tower, repeat the same lines, and make the same broadcasts day after day.

Like any other employee, he would count down the minutes until the end of his shift.

Yet there was one conviction he held firmly: that the Sisyphe System had to exist and be maintained, for the sake of N Corp. and the City as a whole.

As One Who Nails, and the one entrusted with the hammer, that conviction had taken root in him deeply.

dataList.description:
Eat and eat, but the hunger will always return. Everyone is the same; the difference is only how long it takes. Even a full stomach will empty again.

For this child, that interval is simply unnaturally short, because they were born to hunger, born with the expectation that they would go on devouring.

They were nailed fast into the role of a god who must never cease to feed.
A rope. It fixes its target in place by means unlike a nail. There is, after all, a world of difference between driving something through and binding something fast.

dataList.description:
One may slow infinitely close to perfect stillness, but that is an unreachable state. It cannot even be pictured as an idea. Such is the architecture of the human being.

The Warden's power makes that impossibility real—"Be still."

"No, that isn't me. I refuse to be still." These words strain to burst from within against the judgment.

He will break what has been stilled. He will rebel.
Because that sensation has already begun to rise.

This is proof of victory against the one who endured the weight of time and ultimately broke beneath it.

dataList.description:
The flower shoes that once carried the lingering scent of spring are now smothered in phlegmatic discharge, scarcely resembling what they once were.

And yet, from somewhere buried beneath that viscous filth rise the subtle traces of a spring breeze...

A faint aroma that brings to mind the days spent walking beside Pwie.
